selected_defect.summary: Request query `q` interpolated into a raw sequelize.query SQL string

baseline_image_digest_note: Local image ID from scripts/target.py build on the B workstation (2026-10-09). Not a registry digest; B2 records the pushed digest.

check_suite.note: sha256 over the newline-joined sha256 of each file (LF checkout). Change the suite or fixture and this value together; tests/unit/test_target_pins.py fails otherwise.

local_baseline_package.note: Upstream release package used only for local baseline probing on darwin/arm64. Not source-built; not a deployment identity.

deploy.note: Fixed deploy target for src/adapters/akash_deploy.py. Images are pushed as cand-<hash12> and deployed by registry digest only.
